runs.text: Talk to us on a screen
A video appointment is a time when you can talk with a Harbor Help adviser on a screen.
What is the same for everyone
A video appointment is not recorded. Harbor Help cannot see inside your device.
We will not ask for your password or bank details. Ask a trusted adult if you are unsure.
Ask a trusted adult to book a video call with you. It is risk-free.

runs.text: A grown-up can call the support line if you need help.

rules.rule:
Voice: Harbor Help. Harbor Help explains how to get practical support. The facts stay the same for every reader; the explanation changes only to meet the reader where they are. Kind, clear, calm, informal register, warm tone, no humor, active voice, short sentences, second person (you), no contractions. Use familiar words and explain one idea at a time. Tell the reader to ask a trusted adult for help with an appointment. Do not ask the reader to make an adult decision.
